hook: Damage (損) + lose (失): what you lose when things go wrong is a loss.
Exist (存) + continue (続): something that keeps on existing, its continuance.
Retreat (退) + change (化): changing backwards, degeneration.
Big (大) + general outline (概): the big general picture, so mostly, in general.
Body (体) + frame or status (格): the frame of your body, your physique.
Facing (対) + decide (決): face each other to decide who wins, a showdown.
Facing (対) + resist (抗): stand facing and resisting someone, opposition.
Drive back (退) + govern (治): drive out pests or monsters and restore order, extermination.
Big (大) + crowd (衆): the big crowd of ordinary people, the general public.
Facing (対) + handle (処): face a problem and handle it, deal with.
Title (題) + する: to give something a title.
Condition (態) + force (勢): how your forces are set up and ready, your stance or readiness.
Facing (対) + talk (談): two people face each other and talk, a dialogue.
Big (大) + gall bladder or courage (胆): a big gall bladder means lots of guts, bold.
Facing (対) + equal (等): face each other as equals, on equal terms.
Stand or base (台) + none (無し): the base is gone, so everything is spoiled.
Stay stuck (滞) + pay in (納): payments stuck and not paid in, non-payment.
Big (大) + toilet business (便): the big business in the toilet, feces.
Instead of (代) + speech (弁): speak instead of someone, speak for another.
Wait (待) + hope (望): something you wait and hope for, long awaited.
Stage (台) + book (本): the book used on stage, the script.
Instead of (代) + use (用): use one thing instead of another, substitution.
堪 means bear or endure: you bear it, you put up with it.
絶 means cut off or end: a family line is cut off and dies out.
断 means cut or break off: the line breaks off and ceases.
Hit (打) + open (開): hit a problem until it opens, a breakthrough.
Burn (焚) + fire (火): a fire you burn outside, a bonfire.
Peaceful or fair (妥) + cooperate (協): both sides cooperate and settle peacefully, a compromise.
巧 means skillful or clever: skill in your hands, cleverness.
Hit (打) + strike or attack (撃): a hard hit, a blow; in baseball, batting.
Peaceful or fair (妥) + tie (結): tie up a fair deal, an agreement.
Useless (駄) + made work (作): a useless piece of work, a poor work.
Add (足し) + calculation (算): adding calculation, addition.
Many (多) + number (数) + decide (決): the larger number decides, majority rule.
Stand up (立ち) + leave (去る): stand up and go away, to depart.
Stand (立ち) + come close (寄る): pause and come near, stop by.
抱 means hold in your arms: hold a child in your arms, a hug.
Take off or escape (脱) + go out (出): slip off and get out, escape.
Take off or escape (脱) + する: to get out of something, escape from.
Reach (達) + complete (成): reach the goal and complete it, achievement.
Take off (脱) + withdraw (退): take yourself off and withdraw from a group.
Set up (立て) + replace (替える): put up money in place of someone, pay for them first.
Build (建) + front (前): the front you build for show, your public stance.
奉 means offer up with respect: to offer to a god or lord.
Other (他) + move (動) + word (詞): a verb that moves something other, a transitive verb.
Follow a path (辿り) + arrive (着く): follow the way until you finally arrive.
辿 means follow a path: to follow a road or a trail.
束 means bundle: to tie things into a bundle.
Other (他) + side or direction (方): the other side, on the other hand.
Many (多) + busy (忙): many things making you busy, very busy.
給 means give or supply: a lord gives to you, to grant.
溜 means collect or pile up, like water: a place where things collect.
賜 means a gift from above: a superior grants it to you, to bestow.
Many (多) + kinds or ways (様): many kinds of things, diversity.
弛 means loosen, like a bow string: the loose part, slack.
弛 means loosen, like a bow string: to go slack, to loosen.
垂 means hang down: things hang down, droop or drip.
Single (単) + one (一): just one, single.
Short (短) + song or poem (歌): a short poem, the 31 syllable tanka.
Carry on shoulders (担) + frame or shelf (架): a frame you carry a patient on, a stretcher.
Group (団) + tie (結): a group tied together, unity.
Search (探) + examine (検): search and examine new places, exploration.
Decisive (断) + say (言): say it decisively, a firm assertion.
Short (短) + shrink (縮): shrink to make it shorter, shortening.
Decisive (断) + state (然): in a decisive way, absolutely.
Charcoal (炭) + element (素): the element in charcoal, carbon.
Short (短) + university (大): a short university course, junior college.
Single (単) + tone (調): only one tone all the time, monotony.
Single (単) + alone (独): one person alone, solo.
Sounds like 'Donna's man': the master of the house, or a husband.
Short (短) + wave (波): short wave radio.
Egg (蛋) + white (白) + substance (質): egg white substance, protein.
Cut (断) + face or surface (面): the surface you see when you cut it, a cross section.
Bounce (弾) + power (力): the power to bounce back, elasticity.
Govern (治) + peaceful (安): a governed, peaceful town, public order.
Livestock (畜) + produce (産): producing livestock, animal farming.
Livestock (畜) + living thing (生): calling someone a beast, damn!
Land (地) + shape (形): the shape of the land, topography.
Know (知) + nature (性): a nature that knows things, intelligence.
縮 means shrink: something gets shorter and shrinks.
Order or rank (秩) + order or sequence (序): things in proper order.
Block (窒) + breath (息): your breath is blocked, suffocation.
Know (知) + like or related to (的): related to knowing, intellectual.
Put on (着) + hand (手): put your hand on a job, start it.
Put on (着) + colour (色): put colour on, colouring.
Arrive or put on (着) + seat (席): arrive at your seat and sit down.
Put on (着) + eye (目): put your eyes on it, pay attention.
Put on (着) + construction work (工): put hands on the building work, start construction.
Tea (茶) + room (間): the room where the family drinks tea, the living room.
Tea (茶) + hot water (湯): the art of hot water and tea, tea ceremony.
Mid air (宙) + turn over (返り): turn over in mid air, a somersault.
Middle (中) + connect (継): connect in the middle and pass it on, a relay.
Loyal (忠) + tell (告): a loyal friend tells you honestly, advice or warning.
Hit (中, as in hitting a target) + wound (傷): words that hit and wound someone's name, slander.
Middle (中) + pivot (枢): the pivot in the middle, the centre.
Pull out (抽) + choose (選): pull out and choose by luck, a lottery.
Inside (中) + poison (毒): poison gets inside you, poisoning.
Middle (中) + belly (腹): the belly of the mountain, halfway up its side.
Middle (中) + stand (立): stand in the middle, take no side, neutrality.
Middle (中) + soften or harmony (和): meet in the middle and calm it, neutralize.
腸 has the body part (月) radical: the long tubes in your belly, intestines.
蝶 has the insect (虫) radical: a flat winged insect, a butterfly.
Listen (聴) + sense or perceive (覚): sensing by listening, hearing.
Chief or long (長) + government official (官): the chief official, a secretary.
Listen (聴) + lecture (講): listening to a lecture, auditing a class.
Listen (聴) + examine (診) + tool (器): a tool to listen and examine, stethoscope.
Adjust (調) + stop (停): adjust both sides and stop the fight, mediation.
Tune (調) + harmony (和): tuned together in harmony.
Direct (直) + face (面): come face to face directly, confront.
Author or write (著) + book (書): a book someone wrote, their work.
Store (貯) + stock up (蓄): store and stock up money, savings.
Direct (直) + feel (感): feel it directly without thinking, intuition.
Stand out (著) + name (名): a name that stands out, famous.
Dust (塵) + take (取り): the tool that takes the dust, a dustpan.
Fee or wage (賃) + money (金): the money paid for work, wages.
Sink (沈) + 殿, standing in for 澱 (sediment): tiny bits sink and settle at the bottom.
Sink (沈) + go under (没): sink and go under the water, sinking.
Display (陳) + row (列): put things in rows to show, a display.
Chase (追) + reach (及): chase until you reach the truth, investigation.
Chase (追) + tracks (跡): chase the tracks, pursuit.
Chase (追) + release or let go (放): chase someone out and let them go, exile.
費 means expense: spend money or time, use it up.
Fall (墜) + drop (落): fall and drop to the ground, a crash.
Pain (痛) + feel (感): feel it so much it hurts, feel keenly.
Pain (痛) + cut (切): a cutting, painful feeling, keen and deep.
杖 has the wood (木) radical: a wooden stick to lean on, a cane.
Use (使い) + way (道): the way something gets used, its use.
司 means be in charge: to be in charge of, to govern.
つか (束, a fist's width) + time (間): a time as short as a fist is wide, a moment.
Month (月) + line up (並): the same every month, so common and trite.
Join (継) + point (目): the point where two parts are joined, a seam.
尽 means exhaust or use up: to be all used up.
繕 has the thread (糸) radical: fix with thread, mend.
Attach (付け) + add (加える): attach and add one more thing.
突 means thrust or stick out: poke at something.
Poke (突っ) + poke (突く): poke, poke, to nudge someone into action.
謹 means respectful, with the speech (言) radical: be careful with your words, be discreet.
Thrust (突っ) + stretch (張る): push out and stay stretched stiff, to stand firm.
務 means duty: you can do the duty, you are fit for the job.
Work (勤め) + destination (先): where you go to work, your workplace.
努 means effort: with effort, try hard to.
Harbour (津) + wave (波): a wave that hits the harbour, tsunami.
唾 has the mouth (口) radical: what comes from your mouth, spit.
呟 has the mouth (口) radical: talk quietly with your mouth, mutter.
壷 looks like a pot with a lid and a round body: a jar or vase.
蕾 has the grass (艹) radical on top: a plant part before it opens, a bud.
連 means link or in a row: things stand linked in a row.
貫 means pierce through: go right through something.
連 means link or in a row: put things together in a row, to link.
Hang (釣り) + bell (鐘): a big hanging bell at a temple.
Hang (吊り) + leather (革): the hanging leather strap on a train.
Hand (手) + apply (当): money handed to you, or a hand applied to a wound.
Fix (定) + meaning (義): fix the meaning of a word, a definition.
Hold out (提) + offer (供): hold something out and offer it.
Body (体) + cut out clothes (裁): how it is cut and shaped, appearance.
Stop (停) + stay stuck (滞): it stops and stays stuck, stagnation.
Mansion (邸) + house (宅): a big house, a mansion.
Hand (手) + late (遅れ): your hand comes too late to help, too late.
Hand (手) + hang on (掛かり): something to put your hand on, a clue.
Hand (手) + hang on (掛ける): put your own hands on it, to handle.
Hand (手) + number (数): the number of hand steps, trouble or labour.
Suitable (適) + respond (応): respond in a suitable way, adapt.
Suitable (適) + right (宜): as suitable and right, as you see fit.
Suitable (適) + nature (性): a nature suited for it, aptitude.
Hand (手) + edge (際): how neat your hands are at the edges, skill.
Go out (出) + くわす: go out and bump into someone by chance.
Hand (手) + order (順): the order your hands do things, the procedure.
Hand (手) + lock (錠): a lock for your hands, handcuffs.
Hand (手) + number (数): the number of hand steps needed, trouble.
Hand (手) + near (近): near your hand, handy.
Iron (鉄) + steel (鋼): iron and steel.
徹 means go all the way through: devote yourself completely.
Iron (鉄) + stick (棒): an iron stick, a horizontal bar.
Go out (出) + fix or redo (直し): go out again and redo it, a fresh start.
Hand (手) + arrow notch (筈): where your hand fits the arrow, how it should go, the plan.
Hand (手) + pull (引): take someone by the hand and pull, guidance.
Hand (手) + turn (回し): turn things with your hand early, preparations.
Shine (照り) + send back (返す): shine and send the light back, reflect.
Hand (手) + divide (分け): divide the hands, division of labour.
Rice field (田) + garden (園): fields and gardens, the countryside.
Heaven (天) + below (下): everything below heaven, the whole world.
Turn (転) + go around (回): turn around, rotation.
Link (連) + belt (帯): linked by one belt, solidarity.
Link (連) + country (邦): linked countries, a federation.
Link (連) + oath (盟): linked by an oath, a league.
Old (老) + decline (衰): weakening from old age, senility.
Clear (朗) + read (読): read in a clear voice, read aloud.
Wave or wander (浪) + spend (費): spending that drifts away like waves, waste.
Labour (労) + power (力): the power of labour, effort.
Exposed (露) + bone (骨): bones exposed, nothing hidden, blunt.
Argue (論) + discuss (議): argue and discuss, a discussion.
Argument (論) + reason (理): the reason inside an argument, logic.
Confused (惑) + star (星): a star that wanders confusingly in the sky, a planet.
煩 is fire (火) + head (頁): a head burning with worry, so troublesome.
Cross over (渡り) + bird (鳥): a bird that crosses the seas, a migratory bird.
Japan (和) + writing (文): writing in Japanese.
藁 has the grass (艹) radical: dried grass stalks, straw.
Divide (割) + assign (当): divide and assign each a share, a quota.
Split (割) + crowd in (込む): split the line and push in, cut in.
Bad (悪) + person (者): a bad person, a rascal.
